column1: # defxn hand-built UI census baseline -- scripts/ux-component-census.mjs --check fails if a value rises.

# Raised by hand 2026-10-19 (W1-CONTENT), eyebrow/pill/card/stat used-classes and uses only: /resolvers was rebuilt

# are counted. No new pattern was added. Wave 3 converts the page to Ark blocks and lowers these again.

# tokenizer split 'a.b' on the dot and counted property accesses (e.g. stage.title) as class uses; re-measured
# at 5a1ac71 with the corrected tokenizer, field uses was 40. No UI changed.
